description: This file is a test suite for the secrets runtime snapshot authentication integration in a TypeScript project. It contains tests that verify the behavior of secrets runtime snapshots, such as activation, configuration persistence, refresh handling, and agent directory recomputation. It imports testing utilities, configuration helpers, runtime functions, and external modules, and defines multiple test cases using the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.description: Loads the current configuration for the secrets runtime or project.

methods.description: Writes or updates the configuration file for the secrets runtime.
